notes:
Original p.13 identifies the training-passage comparison. The effect size is the printed average g for that outcome, and p is the randomization-test result for the same baseline/intervention outcome. The authors caution on p.12 that summary effect sizes compare A/B observations and are not directly connected to the structured omnibus randomization statistic; they are not identical estimands. Replication not inferred from its abstract or section previews.
Source follow-up: Numerics verified on rendered primary PDF pp. 8–10. No values inferred from figure coordinates. Page 8 contains baseline-to-intervention average g=3.59, p=.042 for training passages and average g=2.06, p=.25 for standard non-training passages. Both also have baseline-to-follow-up tests. Neither supplied description selects the reading-passage type; input order was not used to select it. Primary paper is available.
